name: powerpoint-canvas-controller-macos
description: Control an editable Microsoft PowerPoint canvas on macOS through the native PowerPoint JavaScript API and a local MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Draw and inspect editable PowerPoint slides on macOS.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the active desktop PowerPoint presentation on macOS through Microsoft's PowerPoint JavaScript API and a localhost-only MCP bridge. Shapes, text, pictures, grouped objects, managed connectors, updates, and deletions remain editable. It can inspect slides, validate off-slide geometry, save PPTX files, and export PNG or PDF previews without mouse or keyboard automation.
defaultPrompt: Recreate this figure live as editable PowerPoint objects on macOS.
Inspect and refine the current PowerPoint slide.
Build this presentation step by step at 100 ms intervals.
